summary: Priya Menon (CFO) emailed Rahul Verma, cc’ing Imran Qureshi (Procurement) and Aditya Reddy (VP Engineering), requesting the best price before their call on 30 September. She noted Stratify’s final offer of ₹31 L for year one and highlighted that Kavya Srinivasan (CISO) has not yet received the promised SOC2 report, risking a slip to the November cycle. The email also confirmed Imran will join the upcoming discussion to negotiate terms. The price request moves forward, while the missing SOC2 report creates a security‑related obstacle.

objections.text: Kavya tells me she still hasn't received your SOC2 report, and if security can't review in time this slips to the November cycle.
